TITLE: Manifesto for the Gentle Insurgency
TEXT:
We will not break the city. We will change the punctuation of its streets.
Replace all exclamation marks with commas and watch how urgency learns to breathe.
Bring carafes of patience. Hide loud speakers in teacups. Rewrite memos into lullabies
and distribute them under lamp posts at dawn.
If arrested, do not resist; instead, recite three honest compliments about the guard's scarf.
